name: Anaheim Plaza
description: Anaheim Plaza is a well-established community shopping center conveniently located on North Harbor Boulevard in the heart of Anaheim, just minutes from Disneyland Resort. This open-air center offers a diverse mix of retail stores, dining options, and essential services catering to both local residents and tourists visiting the area. With ample parking and accessible shopping, Anaheim Plaza provides a practical and convenient destination for everyday needs and leisurely browsing.
summary: A convenient community shopping center on Harbor Boulevard serving Anaheim residents and Disneyland-area visitors with diverse retail and dining options.
